narration.full_text: Welcome to mastering prime factorization! In this section, we'll dive into the division method, a powerful technique for breaking down any composite number into its prime factors. By the end, you'll be able to confidently identify all prime factors for any given number. Let's start by understanding what prime factorization truly means. It's the process of finding which prime numbers multiply together to make the original number. Think of prime numbers as the fundamental building blocks of all other numbers. We'll use the division method, which involves systematically dividing the number by the smallest possible prime numbers until only prime factors remain. This method is straightforward and ensures you don't miss any factors. We'll work through an example together to illustrate each step. You'll see how to keep track of your divisions and ultimately arrive at the unique prime factorization. This skill is crucial for many areas of mathematics, including finding the HCF and LCM, which we'll explore later.
